personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center optimized for fast scanning, night driving, and strict compliance tracking without visual fatigue.

spacing.rule: Dense but highly structured. Use generous spacing (md/lg) between distinct sections (e.g., Map vs Tachograph) but tight spacing (xs/sm) within metric groups and stat clusters.

do's: Use solid dark surfaces instead of glass to ensure maximum legibility and contrast during night shifts.
dont's: No blur or frosted glass; prioritize battery efficiency and harsh contrast for instant readability.

screens.name: Tachograph Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: A live operational view showing remaining driving time, EU compliance rings, and manual state selector.

states.loading: Skeleton of the progress rings and stat cards using surfaceTertiary.
states.empty: N/A for core dashboard, defaults to '0h 00m' if no shift started.
states.error: High-contrast error card showing 'Tachograph connection lost' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Top half: oversized circular progress metric (Rajdhani) showing remaining drive time. Middle: segmented control for states (Driving, Work, Available, Rest). Bottom: scrollable list of today's logged events.

screens.name: Navigation & Map
screens.purpose: Truck-specific routing map prioritizing vehicle dimensions and weight limits.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map behind a floating top search bar. A floating bottom sheet handles route preview, time estimation, and active vehicle dimensions warning.

screens.purpose: Configure dimensions, weight, axles, and HAZMAT for accurate routing.

states.empty: Illustration of a truck with 'No active vehicle selected'.
states.error: Form validation errors in red below inputs.

screens.name: Logbook / History
screens.purpose: Compliance log showing daily/weekly driving, rest, and work times for EU regulations.

states.empty: Illustration of a logbook indicating 'No driving history found'.
states.error: Error fetching logs with 'Retry Sync' button.

screens.layout: Chronological timeline feed. Each row highlights state changes with colored indicators (Green for rest, Amber for driving) and mono-spaced timestamps.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the <Rules> strictly: Use native mobile patterns, ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt, and respect the safe area.

The app uses the '7 Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. Do NOT invert colors or introduce light mode. This app is designed for truck cabins, prioritizing a tactical, high-contrast dark mode to prevent night-driving fatigue.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. Rely on solid surfaces (`surfaceSecondary`, `surfaceTertiary`) and thin dividers (`divider`) to separate components. This ensures maximum legibility.
Typography hierarchy relies heavily on 'Rajdhani' for large metrics, clocks, and tachograph numbers, and 'IBM Plex Sans' for forms, labels, and lists.
Never use blue, indigo, or purple. The primary brand color is Amber (#FF9F0A), which signifies active tracking and utility.

Status indicators are critical for EU compliance: use the provided `success` (green) for Rest/Available states, `brandPrimary` (amber) for Driving/Work, `warning` (yellow) for nearing limits, and `error` (red) for violations.
Include haptics on status state toggles and tab switches for tactile feedback while driving.
Implement a persistent bottom button for the Vehicle Profile form and use oversized segmented controls for the tachograph state selection.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims if layering text over the hero image on the splash or profile screens.
